question: Which other Mexican Formula One race car driver has held the podium besides the Force India driver born in 1990?

steps.thought:
Which Mexican Formula One race car drivers have held the podium besides the Force India driver born in 1990?

Observation: Carlos Slim Helmer has held the podium in Formula 1 besides the Force India driver born in 1990. Sergio Pérez also holds the nationality of Mexico and has raced the podium.
